author: severause
title: SeverActions
tagline: Action, prompt and trigger pack for SkyrimNet NPCs
description: SeverActions expands SkyrimNet with LLM-driven actions (companion control, outfits, arrest, economy and debt, crafting, travel, combat and brawl, enterprises, camping and more), context-awareness prompts (merchant, familiarity and reputation, survival, off-screen life), and event triggers. Actions are grouped into drill-down categories; prompts add situational context for NPC dialogue.
